sources.title: 2026 Government greenhouse gas conversion factors for company reporting: Methodology paper

facts.source_fact: RoPax factors are based on mixed passenger-and-vehicle ferry data for UK routes.
The underlying study includes route distance, passenger numbers, car numbers, freight units and fuel consumption.
Passenger-km, tonne-km and CO2 emissions are calculated from operator-supplied information.
Ferry CO2 is allocated between passengers and freight using transported tonnage.
Passenger allocation includes passenger, luggage and car weights.
Freight allocation includes freight load plus vehicle or container weight.
The methodology provides a further distinction between foot passengers and passengers with cars.
Passenger-with-car factors are intended on a single-person basis rather than for the entire vehicle.
The published RoPax factor is relevant to ferries carrying both passengers and freight.
Passenger-only ferries are excluded from this basis and are expected to have different factors.
